name: What structured data or schema do I need to implement for AEO software to work properly?

mainEntity.name: What structured data or schema do I need to implement for AEO software to work properly?

acceptedAnswer.text: You need FAQ schema, How-to schema, Article schema, Organization schema, and Local Business schema to maximize AEO software effectiveness. These structured data types give AI systems machine-readable context about your content's meaning, questions, steps, and business credibility.
acceptedAnswer.description: Implement FAQPage, HowTo, Article, Organization, and LocalBusiness schema. These give AI systems clear, machine-readable context about your questions, steps, and business authority.
